description: boolean/fuse-cylinder-tangent-inside-near-seam with the touching ruling 1.4e-3 rad off both seams: the inner seam crosses each outer cap 2.35e-7 inside the rim, past its tolerance, 4.2e-4 along it from the touch, and the section circle's piece between the two hugs the rim. The fuse builds the closed form, V = 2.43 pi, but the crescent cap's polygons cross near the touch: the rim's chord from the touch sags past that short piece's sample, so Full refuses L5 (loop 0 intersects itself) and the mesher refuses the face at every chord, the cusp's polygons of docs/BACKLOG.md's loop with a cusp at a coarse chord at the checker's own chord. Between one and about sixty tolerances off the rim, depending on the radii, some angles do this; nearer, the crossing is on the rim and builds green (the retired tangency-faults plan). The desired assertion: it builds Full-green to the closed form
